'''Carlos Gustavo Tamm de Araújo Moreira''' (born 8 February 1973) is a Brazilian [[mathematician]] working on [[dynamical system]]s, [[ergodic theory]], [[number theory]] and [[combinatorics]]. Moreira is currently a researcher at the [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada]] (IMPA), where he goes by the nickname "Gugu".<ref name="ABC">{{cite web|url=http://www.abc.org.br/~cgmoreira |title=Academia Brasileira de Ciências |publisher=Abc.org.br |accessdate=2015-05-22 |language=Portuguese |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150526154107/http://www.abc.org.br/~cgmoreira |archivedate=May 26, 2015 }}</ref><ref name="umalca">{{cite web|url=http://3clam.umalca.org/wp-content/uploads/2009/04/premioUmalca/Moreira-Brazil.pdf |title=UMALCA – The Mathematical Work of Carlos Gustavo Moreira |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20131204204512/http://3clam.umalca.org/wp-content/uploads/2009/04/premioUmalca/Moreira-Brazil.pdf |archivedate=2013-12-04 }}</ref> He is also a member of the Brazilian Mathematical Olympiad Commission, a fanatic fan of the Brazilian football team [[Clube de Regatas do Flamengo|Flamengo]] and a member of the [[Brazilian Communist Party]] (PCB).

Moreira obtained his Ph.D. from [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada|IMPA]]  under the supervision of [[Jacob Palis]] in 1993, at the age of 20.<ref name="umalca" /><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=53774 |title=The Mathematics Genealogy Project – Carlos Gustavo de Araujo Moreira |publisher=Genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu |date= |accessdate=2015-05-22}}</ref> He is a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]] since 2008.<ref name="ABC" /> In 2009 he was awarded the [[:es:Unión Matemática de América Latina y el Caribe|UMALCA]] Award for his contributions to mathematics.<ref name="umalca" />

Moreira is the recipient of the [[TWAS Prize]] in Mathematics in 2010.<ref name="Prizes and Awards">{{Cite web |url=https://twas.org/article/twas-announces-2010-prize-winners |title=Prizes and Awards |date=2016 |publisher=The World Academy of Sciences}}</ref> He was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] of 2014 in [[Seoul]], [[South Korea]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |title=International Mathematical Union (IMU) |publisher=Mathunion.org |date= |accessdate=2015-05-22 |archive-date=2017-11-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171124141541/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.aparecidanet.com.br/brasil-tera-quatro-palestrantes-maior-evento-internacional-de-matematica/ |title=Brasil terá quatro palestrantes no maior evento internacional de matemática • Aparecidanet |publisher=Aparecidanet.com.br |date=2014-06-20 |accessdate=2015-05-22 |language=Portuguese |archive-date=2015-10-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151005062136/https://www.aparecidanet.com.br/brasil-tera-quatro-palestrantes-maior-evento-internacional-de-matematica/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> and a plenary speaker at the 2018 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.icm2018.org/portal/en/icm-speakers |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-07-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171207193725/http://www.icm2018.org/portal/en/icm-speakers |archive-date=2017-12-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
